programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga

programme.title: Satya

programme.title: Khel

programme.desc: Fired Up. Ree whips up a Tex-Mex feast for her crew. She makes chicken tortilla casserole with enchilada sauce and Mexican fruit cocktail - perfect crowd-pleasing dishes. S11, Ep3

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Packaged With Love. Ree and her daughter prepare a care package for Ladd's grandmother. They bake a courgette cake. Plus, she makes a cheesy escalloped cabbage casserole. S11, Ep4

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Surprise! Ree is throwing a surprise birthday party for his son. She cooks all his favourite dishes, including smashed burgers with beer-battered onion strings and dark brownies. S11, Ep5

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Perfect Picnic. Ree is having a picnic with friends. She makes chicken Milanese and a Mediterranean orzo salad. Plus, she bakes Pina Colada cakes for dessert! S11, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: What Are Friends For? Ina cooks for a friend who has recently moved to a new house. She makes her popular mac and cheese, a radishes appetizer and peach and raspberry shortcakes. S6, Ep5

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Long Island Food. Ina wants to give her guests a taste of the Hamptons. She rustles up a roast beef and horseradish sandwich, a seafood salad as well as a plum and raspberry crumble. S6, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The Final. The remaining bakers make a perfect picnic, a summer classic and a baked celebration of our planet. Who will be crowned the winner? S13, Ep10

programme.title: Rachel Allen's Cake Diaries
programme.desc: Cakes For The Boys. Rachel bakes cakes for hungry lads. Recipes include marbled chocolate crumble cake, ginger golden syrup loaf, cheesecake brownies and almond cake. S1, Ep3

programme.title: River Cottage Everyday
programme.desc: Fish. Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall shows a house of students how to prepare dishes using cheap, sustainable seafood with home-made fish suppers and Thai curries. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Nadiya's Simple Spices
programme.desc: Nadiya delivers some thrifty dishes. She serves up fragrant biryani, cumin-infused potato burgers, and a twist on a classic shortbread. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Nadiya's Simple Spices
programme.desc: Nadiya makes a one-plate pie with a masala mince and butter bean filling, and a bundt cake. Plus, food writer Gurdeep Loyal makes a shoofly pie. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Worldwide Flavorfest. This trip, Guy's getting a taste of global flavour. In Cincinnati, Jamaican jerk chicken and spicy snapper, and in Duluth, Thai-style burritos and lamb curry. S21, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Small Town Standouts. Guy hits some small towns with big flavours on this trip. In Wisconsin, he finds a roadside bar serving sandwiches stuffed with brisket and crispy pork belly. S21, Ep5

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Cooking The Books. Jamie and Francine, the owners of California's Sisley Italian Kitchen, believe their bookkeeper may be responsible for a revenue discrepancy. S3, Ep13

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Chef's Choice. Patrick, owner of Buster's Beach House in Long Beach, wants to investigate rumours that his executive chef is showing preferential treatment amongst the wait staff. S4, Ep1

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Waves, Watermelons And Wipe Outs. A Jersey Shore surf shop owner wants a summery cake for a surfing contest. And, Mauro gets melon fever with a cake order for a watermelon festival! S10, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Guy's Hometown Tour. Guy Fieri returns to his home town of Ferndale, CA. He checks out a generations-old apple orchard and the place where he first worked in the kitchen. S19, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: International Family Style. Guy Fieri takes a seat at the family table! He checks out a sibling-run Vietnamese joint in Utah serving up mum's legendary recipes for authentic dishes. S19, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Roadtrippin' In Beantown. Just outside Boston, in Allston, two restaurants share one kitchen cooking up totally different menus - Mexican street food and gastropub standouts. S21, Ep1

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 16-Minute Meals: Summer. Ree cooks up four great 16-minute summer meals. On the menu: lime salmon, a selection of light Greek dishes, pasta with pesto and peas and zucchini noodles. S13, Ep12

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Deli Food Showdown. Ree tests recipes for her deli with some help from her friends. She makes two chicken salads, one with grapes and one curried and two quiches to choose from. S13, Ep9

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Fixin' Fence, Fixin' Lunch. Ree cooks a hearty Tex-Mex lunch for Ladd and Cowboy Tim who are out fixing fences. There's grilled steak with quesadillas, spicy beans and ranch salad. S13, Ep10

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Well Done, Dad. Ree celebrates her dad's retirement by cooking his favourite foods. She makes beef stew, cheese casserole, delicious green beans and mini chocolate-cherry cakes. S13, Ep11

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Chicken, Chicken, Chicken. Ree demonstrates the benefits of bulk buying by showing how to make three dishes with chicken: slow cooked with broccoli, chicken pie and in Caesar salad. S13, Ep13

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Dorm Room Dining. Ree shares some simple tips for minimal prep food made with basic tools. She makes pizzas, paninis and quesadillas on a waffle maker and salad in a bag. S12, Ep1

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Sarah Raven. Gardener Sarah Raven cooks up a stunning dish in Prue's kitchen. Plus, there's a fool proof hack for making a perfect vinaigrette salad dressing. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Jamie's Great Britain
programme.desc: South Wales. Jamie travels over the Severn bridge to South Wales. He learns the massive impact the Welsh coal boom had on our food culture in the late 19th century and beyond. S1, Ep3

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Northumberland. James samples the delights of Northumberland, joined by Michelin-starred chef Kenny Atkinson. They learn how mead is made on Holy Island. S1, Ep13

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Isle of Man. James visits the Isle of Man during its famous TT warm-up week. He's joined by Michelin-starred chef and fellow petrolhead, Lisa Goodwin-Allen. S1, Ep14

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein forages for golden chanterelles and mushrooms in Norfolk, for a kidney breakfast dish. Plus, he tries charcuterie for the first time. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein visits Yorkshire's largest rhubarb growing area, and then bakes his favourite dessert - a rhubarb crumble. Plus, he makes a delicious rabbit pie. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein explores Wales' amazing produce. He cooks a rice pilaf with Welsh mussels. Plus, he visits a salt marsh lamb farm in North Wales. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein cooks a flavourful boiled mutton with caper sauce. Plus, he visits a family that own highland cattle in Scotland. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein explores Scotland's fantastic produce. He cooks venison with morello cherries and hazelnut spaetzle. Plus, he tries eel straight out of the smoker. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: It's spring and Rick Stein's Seafood Restaurant in North Cornwall fills up very quickly. On the menu is Rick's seafood paella with squid and hake with parsley sauce. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick makes delicious dishes using local, Cornish delicacies. He catches some fine mullet and for the first time attempts to make a fish tagine using a Moroccan recipe. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick travels to France to recall some of his early culinary influences. He samples great sea food dishes in Bayonne and famous for the best seafood in France, Marseilles. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick attempts to convert a fish phobic Henry, by catching a sea bass together and grilling it with a vanilla sauce. Plus, he shows a tasty way of cooking plaice. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick cooks up a fish feast for Padstow's May Day celebrations. He makes some red mullet pasta, steamed oysters, cod Portuguese, crabmeat pasties and squid spring rolls. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Sarah Raven. Gardener Sarah Raven cooks up a stunning dish in Prue's kitchen. Plus, there's a fool proof hack for making a perfect vinaigrette salad dressing. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Beef Bonanza. Guy Fieri is on the road looking for unique beef dishes. He finds meaty ravioli in Delaware, meatloaf in San Diego, and a tasty Middle-Eastern fare in Texas. S30, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Spinning The Globe. Guy Fieri is checking out eateries with global flavours. After a shocking twist on tacos in Kansas City, a food truck in Texas serves up meatless Mexican food. S30, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Cross Country Comfort Food. Guy Fieri seeks comfort food from the slopes to the sea. In Utah, a local boy serves a gourmet chivito club and a ski lodge dishes out crispy pork belly. S19, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Righteous Bites. Guy Fieri checks out dishes on both sides of the Pacific. There are platefuls of guilty pleasures in LA and in Monterey, CA, a spot on the pier serves fresh fish. S19, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Goin' The Extra Mile. Guy Fieri visits food joints big on comfort foods. In Chicago a burger place has Asian flair and in Hawaii a gas station joint does kalua pork and mahi mahi! S15, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Savory Standouts. Guy Fieri slams on the brakes for some enticing eats! In Memphis, a high-end chef takes Southern staples to a new level with dishes like chorizo meatloaf. S15, Ep3
